Re: Safety Concerns at the Basketball Courts at Knapp Ranch Park
1 message

Rap Commissioners <rap.commissioners@lacity.org>  Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 9:52 AM
To: Arash Nikooei
Cc: PublicInfo RAP <RAP.PublicInfo@lacity.org>, Councilmember Lee <councilmember.lee@lacity.org>, Myrka Martinez
<myrka.martinez@lacity.org

 Good morning,

 Thank you for your email, which has been forwarded to the Commissioners and Valley Region staff.

 Our staff is currently reviewing the information you provided and will reach out to you directly if any further details are
 needed.

 On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 10:01 AM Arash Nikooei  wrote:
  Good morning,

  I wanted to follow up on my August 17 email regarding the safety concerns and deteriorating conditions of the
  basketball courts at Knapp Ranch Park.

  We received confirmation that our email was forwarded to the Recreation and Park Commissioners, but we have not
  received any further response or information regarding an inspection or next steps.

  Given the condition of the courts and the history of serious injuries outlined in our original email, could you please let us
  know who has been assigned to review this matter and whether an inspection of the courts can be scheduled?

  We would greatly appreciate an update when possible.

  Thank you,
  Arash Nikooei

  On Aug 17, 2026, at 10:07 AM, Rap Commissioners <rap.commissioners@lacity.org> wrote:

  Good morning,
  Thank you for contacting the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners Office, your email will be
  forwarded to the Commissioners.
